title: Vintage Disney Steamboat Willie Mickey Mouse Glass Mug - Used
descriptionText: This vintage glass mug features the iconic Steamboat Willie character from the Disney franchise. It is a perfect addition to any Disneyana collection or a great gift for a fan of the classic black-and-white cartoon. The mug is made of high-quality glass and has a sturdy construction, ensuring it can withstand daily use for years to come. The design is eye-catching and features the beloved character in a fun and playful way. This mug is a must-have for any Disney collector or fan.
